statement.title: Representatives of $\mathscr R_4$ up to Clifford conjugacy
statement.full_tex: A list of $1{,}020$ gates of the form~\eqref{core:eq:row} on four qubits contains a Clifford conjugate of every $h\in\mathscr R_4$. Exactly ten listed $M$ have $|N(M)|-1\ge63$, and they lie in $\C_2(4)$.

finite_domain: 32,768 triangular seeds, 2,064 involutions, 163,216 affine-closed point maps, 43 phase forests and 2,818,048 phase rows; the 1,020 listed gates.

covered_subclaims: Complete coverage of the forms (core:eq:row) up to Clifford conjugacy by the 1,020 listed gates; N(M) for each of them; the ten with |N(M)|-1 >= 63 lie in C_2(4).
All supplied affine conjugators, the 43 phase forests, complete row coverage and the invariants of all 1,020 gates, including the ten-gate conclusion.

checker_conventions: paper/conventions.json; each checker states its coordinate order in its docstring
